tooltip.zh_CN: 每名正在工作的文化专家额外获得3点食物和3点生产力，各专业等级均保持此加成。

tooltip.zh_CN: 每名正在工作的文化专家额外提供大作家、大艺术家和大音乐家基础点数各2点，并正常受到伟人点数百分比加成。剧院广场及其每一级建筑各提供1点住房。

abilities.mechanical_contract: Retain SHARED-001/002 Culture branch, shared pillage eligibility; one package.

tooltip.zh_CN: 每个游戏时代可通过同名城市项目重新诠释本城馆藏一次。项目需连续占用一个完整城市生产回合；完成时，每个不同馆藏时代使城市永久累计5个百分点的巨作原生产出倍率，历次相加。累计倍率与已用启动时代额度随城保留，仅当前文化身份且启用三级能力时生效；离开文化身份后不能开始新对话。

abilities.mechanical_contract: contracts.dialogue; X=current distinct eligible work eras at successful completion; gain=5 percentage points*X; total=min(balanceCap,sum gains). Only native yields, excludes Meaning Extension additions.
output_effects: city historical accumulated native GreatWork percentage; current Culture ACTIVE3 effect gate

tooltip.zh_CN: 本城典藏的不同时代巨作塑造城市审美。每个不同巨作时代，使本城每座合格普通建筑产生1点旅游业绩；被掠夺建筑不计入，地块改良设施不适用。

abilities.mechanical_contract: Each current eligible ordinary building gains Tourism=1*current distinct eligible work eras. Not per work count; no historical maximum.
abilities.notes_compatibility: Use shared facts/events/bounded reconciliation; no periodic per-second scans.

tooltip.zh_CN: 本城其它专业领域从不同角度诠释巨作。每个合格领域每有1点区域完善度，每件合格巨作便获得0.5份该领域代表产出；金币每份为3点。各领域先换算为实际产出并分别向下取整，再将同产出领域相加，最后按合格巨作件数计算总追加量。追加值独立计算，不受时代对话或主题化放大；即使追加值也是文化，也不因此成为作品原生产出。

abilities.mechanical_contract: For each eligible domain d, per_work_d=floor(0.5*Shared.DomainDevelopment(d)*Shared.YIELD_SHARE(yield_d)); per_work_y=sum(per_work_d for domains mapped to y); total_y=per_work_y*eligible work count W. Floor after per-domain share conversion, before same-yield addition and W; Meaning Extension only, not GPP. Meaning additions remain independent of Great Work yield amplification: neither Dialogue nor theming amplifies them. Government/Diplomatic Culture additions remain Meaning by origin, never native work Culture just because the YieldType matches.
abilities.notes_compatibility: Use shared facts/events/bounded reconciliation; no periodic per-second scans.

tooltip.zh_CN: 巨作启发不同领域未来的杰出人才。每件合格巨作，为对应领域提供其区域完善度×0.1的基础伟人点数，正常受到伟人点数百分比加成；不产生大作家、大艺术家或大音乐家点数。

abilities.mechanical_contract: Per mapped noncultural GP domain: baseGPP/turn=0.1*Shared.DomainDevelopment(d)*eligible work count. Include Prophet; no custom overflow conversion.
abilities.notes_compatibility: Use shared facts/events/bounded reconciliation; no periodic per-second scans.

tooltip.zh_CN: 可以训练人文考察团，前往其它文明开展风土考察、艺文采撷和奇观巡礼。每个来源城市对每个外国文明的每类考察只能成功完成一次，每次获得1份文化见闻，提高来源城市整体旅游业绩，并可通过国内文化网络传播其价值。 考察完成后单位保留，可继续考察。

work_pool.known_definition: Use recognized, explicitly supported work definitions; matching broad object category alone does not auto-admit unknown Mod works.
work_pool.era: Historical era belonging to the work; current loaded data has GreatWorks.EraType for all supported categories; creator association can provide validated equivalent semantics. Artifact own era. Unknown/unreliable work metadata excluded, never player/current/acquisition era substitution.

dialogue.quota: One successful completion per City x START Game Era, independent of owner. Owner change does not reset used quota. X=0 allowed, successful completion consumes opportunity. No banking unspent past eras.
dialogue.duration: Exactly one full uninterrupted city production turn regardless of Production or overflow; interruption restarts full continuous turn requirement, no low-cost substitute.
dialogue.sample: Era diversity sampled on completion, not start.
dialogue.accumulation: Add permanent percentage points subject to future cap, city state not individual work state; new works benefit, departed works carry nothing. Retained history is not an unconditional current effect; follows A city historical lifecycle.
dialogue.active: Current Culture Identity and ACTIVE>=3 required for accumulated effect. Governor departure/ACTIVE<3 retain history and pause effect; Identity exit retains history, pauses effect and disallows new Dialogue. Unsupported owner freezes use/growth. Ongoing-project interruptions are outside this A–D amendment.
dialogue.ownership: A city historical legacy: accumulated successful modifier and used City x START Game Era quota/deduplication follow the persistent city, never original-owner copies. Any enabled owner meeting current Culture Identity/ACTIVE3 may use retained history; Owner change never resets used quota.
dialogue.target: DESIGN_PREFERRED all eligible Great Work NATIVE yields incl Tourism; never Meaning Extension appended yields.
dialogue.fallback: If reliable city-level all-native path unavailable, allowed Tourism-only technical fallback must be reported and distinguished before adoption; native-only restriction still applies.
dialogue.precision: Native floor accepted for this percentage effect; no compensation layer. Always display accumulated percentage even if no integer yield increment.

expedition.training: Culture ACTIVE4; no invented capacity. Cost copies current Spy production cost, deployment copies Spy distance/time relationship, not map walking.
expedition.source: Permanently bound to training city. Existing unit can execute and gain records despite source ACTIVE falling below4.
expedition.mission_success: Deterministic success for valid missions; no espionage failure/capture/death/diplomatic penalties.
expedition.after_success_unit: Retain unit, allow redeployment and other unfinished missions; user confirmed.
expedition.duration: floor(2 * game speed turn-duration multiplier relative to Standard); deployment additional; do not add unapproved minimum or round convention.
expedition.diplomacy: Met, living other Major Civilization plus mission-specific valid target. City-States explicitly excluded in first version with future expansion candidate; Free Cities excluded as non-stable cultural subjects. No Open Borders, Embassy, Alliance, foreign or domestic Trade Route, or other added diplomatic permission.
expedition.war_transition: War permits deployment, mission start, continuation and successful completion. Declaration of war alone never cancels mission. Non-hostile deterministic success, no capture/death/espionage failure/diplomatic penalty remain. Any engine-forced recall/reset is TECHNICAL_INVESTIGATION_REQUIRED / IMPLEMENTATION_LIMITATION, not a Design exception.
expedition.target_invalidation: If target loses required works, current capital changes, city changes owner or civilization eliminated: cancel with no gain/no successful quota consumption; retain unit for redeployment. War itself is not target invalidation.
expedition.presentation: Deployment/Target/Mission UI target; show foreign civ three category completion states, no automatic Spy capacity inheritance.

observations.unique_key: D0040 replaces original-owner key: (sourceCity, foreignCivilization, insightCategory). Owner is not record ownership or uniqueness key. Each source city retains one successful record per civilization/category across transfers; bound unit credits training city under existing source contract.
observations.award: Each first successful key awards1 nonspendable/nontradeable observation.
observations.theoretical_max: One record per source city x civilization x category, no Owner reset/era reset/cooldown/infinite repetition. 3*N is the corresponding effective foreign-civilization range, not a promise that changing Owner grants new quota. Historical total and current effective count are distinct; foreign civilization later dying does not erase history.
observations.ownership: A city historical legacy: Culture Insights and completed categories follow the persistent source city. ACTIVE/Governor decline and Culture Identity exit retain history; effects follow current Culture gates. Unsupported owner freezes use/growth. Any enabled owner requalifies using same city ledger, not original-owner copy; receiver acquires no history.
observations.tourism: With supported current owner, Culture Identity and ACTIVE>=4: overall city Tourism percent=K_T*current effective Insights count after current-owner own-civilization filter; historical total alone is not effective total. K_T candidate1–3 not chosen.
observations.completed_civ: A civilization enters source S_i only if this source city ledger individually contains all3 categories and civilization is not current Owner own civilization. No owner sub-ledger and no partial cross-source assembly.
observations.current_owner_filter: Effective Insights = city historical Insights minus records concerning current Owner own civilization. Exclude only from current effect and completed-civilization payload, never physically delete history or reset category quota. Later Owner changes reinclude records when that civilization is foreign again.

network_effect.slot: Separate from ability packages; domestic existing topology, no foreign trade route required.
network_effect.source: Valid current Culture ACTIVE4 source uses city historical Insights under current supported owner; downgrade/Identity exit retains history but withdraws current source qualification. Apply current-owner own-civilization filter.
network_effect.payload: Each source i forms S_i from civilizations individually completed People+Works+Places in its city history, excluding current Owner own civilization. Never combine partial records across sources; effective filtered S_i is the payload, not raw historical total.
network_effect.receiver: Only working specialists corresponding to receiver single specialization Identity; not all specialists; no Identity means no matching beneficiary.
network_effect.formula: Additional Culture per eligible working specialist=K_C*C_receiver; K_C=parameters.network_culture_K (currently1).
network_effect.merge: S_receiver=union(S_i for all currently valid connected Culture sources i); C_receiver=cardinality(S_receiver). Same civilization counted once. No sum of source counts and no max-source rule.
network_effect.ownership: Receiver does not acquire observations, cannot re-export as own payload; existing authorized center distribution topology retained.
network_effect.replaces: Old Culture Eureka boost withdrawn from new Design. Research Inspiration network retained pending NETWORK_REDESIGN_REQUIRED.

meaning_multipliers.current_rule: D0041 latest user direction: Meaning additions stay independent; neither Dialogue nor theming amplifies them. Original native work yields retain their own normal effects.
meaning_multipliers.source_boundary: All Meaning additions are excluded, including Government Plaza and Diplomatic Quarter Culture. A shared YieldType never converts appended yield into native yield.
meaning_multipliers.amount: Existing per-domain Floor -> same-yield sum -> eligible work count W is the fixed additional amount. No multiplier compensation or altered K/Floor is authorized.
meaning_multipliers.technical_gate: Flat coexistence, native-only Dialogue and theme-independent additions must be measured separately. Reading aggregate work yields cannot establish native/appended provenance or prove a primitive isolates it.
meaning_multipliers.future_option: The earlier suggestion that theming includes Meaning is retained for possible future user Design change, not the current accepted rule. Preserve prototype evidence for that decision.
meaning_multipliers.scope: This clarification concerns Great Work yield amplification discussed here. It does not silently invent exemptions from unrelated city/civilization-wide modifiers or settle all engine stacking algorithms.
meaning_multipliers.tourism: Meaning has no Tourism output; native Tourism may be a separate multiplier control, not Meaning Tourism.

review_markers.topic: D0040 SUPERSEDES original-owner uniqueness: sourceCity + foreignCivilization + insightCategory; Owner not ownership key.
Met living foreign majors eligible; City-States excluded first version, FUTURE_EXPANSION candidate; Free Cities excluded.
D0040 both Dialogue and Insights are distinct A city historical assets; independent effect gates, no original-owner Insights partition.
review_markers.observations: City-owned records with current-owner own-civilization effective filter; history/quota never deleted.
review_markers.dialogue: City-scoped total modifier and City x START Game Era quota; retained across owner/Identity changes, current Culture ACTIVE3 use gate.

review_markers.topic: Union of independently fully examined civilization sets; deduplicate same civilization; never assemble partial records across sources.

technical_flags: Exactly one full city production turn despite overflow and interruption
Native-only Great Work all-yield percentage, excluding appended Meaning yields; fallback report gate
Spy-style independent non-hostile unit without capacity/risk, deployment/mission and war-transition engine behavior
Known work registry/era resolution and ordinary-building taxonomy adapters

Independent city Dialogue/Insights ledgers, effective-owner filtering, successful action idempotency and save contract; ongoing projects/tasks/unit ownership remain E/G, no implementation in this Design batch.

D0041: prototype flat-yield coexistence and Dialogue/theming independence; explicit ScalingFactor100 is an unproven candidate, not a confirmed repair. No formal cutover without native gates and separate authorization.
superseded_old_rules: Old Culture Lv3 +5F5P and population Culture removed.
Old Lv4 per-specialist cityCulture percent removed.
Dynamic25%*(eraCount-1)Dialogue replaced by city-scoped permanent project accumulation.

Old GreatWork BASE-adjacency yields replaced by Meaning Extension DistrictDevelopment shares. D0038 explicitly accepts per-domain floor after share conversion, then same-yield addition and finally work count for Meaning Extension only; no GPP rounding authorization.
Old Culture Eureka boost replaced by new observations network; Research unchanged pending redesign.

D0040 supersedes CUL-REVIEW-01/03 original-owner/source-city Insights ownership and non-inheritance; both history and category quota follow city, effective own-civilization records temporarily excluded. Dialogue city history and independent3/3 Network union retained.

observations.zh_CN: 文化见闻是来源城市保留的历史文化经验，不是可消费资源。每来源城对每外国文明每类只能成功一次，记录随城保留。当前主人自身文明的见闻暂不参与有效数量和完整文明集合，但不删除；合格文化四级城市利用当前有效见闻提高整体旅游业绩，完整考察成果可经国内网络支持接收城市本专业专家。

project.zh_CN: 连续占用一个完整城市生产回合，在完成时根据当前馆藏时代数增加时代对话倍率。成功后占用启动时代的次数；零时代馆藏也会消耗机会。

unit.zh_CN: 绑定训练来源城，通过部署前往外国城市开展非敌对考察。成本参照间谍，部署时间另计；任务耗时按游戏速度缩放。

future_candidates.description_zh_CN: 城邦具有文化价值，但当前三维度完整文明考察以主要文明为对象。未来可独立设计城邦文化交流/考察；本轮不定义类别、奖励或见闻。
